user.title: Vent-Axia Econiq
user.description: Connect to your Vent-Axia Econiq unit's built-in MQTT broker. Credentials are extracted from the Vent-Axia Connect app's local storage; see the README for the recipe.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the unit. Verify host/port reachability and that no firewall blocks port 8883.
error.invalid_auth: TLS-PSK or MQTT auth was rejected. Re-extract the credentials from the Vent-Axia Connect app.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Vent-Axia Econiq unit is already configured.
